purpose: Explain a precaution by naming the outcome that must be avoided.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Verb て-form + はいけないから
Let us take jackets so that we do not catch a cold.
Let us leave early so that we do not miss the train.
I will make a note so that I do not forget.
formation: Verb て-form + はいけないから
restrictions: Here てはいけない refers to an undesirable outcome, not necessarily a rule directed at someone.
mistake: Be explicit about the precaution; the phrase supplies its reason.
